verdict.rationale: Gladia documents an official CLI: one-command install with API key setup and `gladia transcribe audio.mp3` [gladia-docs-23]. Output can be plain text, JSON, SRT or VTT to stdout [gladia-docs-24], is machine-readable for scripts and CI [gladia-docs-25], and the CLI generates shell completions [gladia-docs-26]. A probe confirmed the dedicated CLI docs page exists [gladia-probe-5]. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, evidence of command coverage beyond pre-recorded transcription (e.g., live streaming or other API features)
